name: baudrier
description: Runtime dependencies for Baudrier, the Claude Code plugin by Calopsys. Installed into ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA} by the SessionStart hook, never into the read-only plugin cache.
comment: VERSIONS ARE PINNED EXACTLY, NOT RANGED, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE.
Scaleway's npm release pipeline is currently broken: the most recent publish
of every @scaleway/* package ships only package.json, README.md and LICENSE,
with no dist/ directory, while still declaring `exports` that point into
dist/. Verified against registry.npmjs.org itself (fileCount: 3), so it is
3.11.1 + 2.4.2 is the last combination where all 56 transitive @scaleway
packages resolve with dist/ present. A caret range here would resolve to a
broken release and fail at import time with a confusing ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
